headline: Irani Reports R$56.5 Million Q3 Profit as Adjusted EBITDA Rises
summary: Irani Papel e Celulose posted a third-quarter profit of R$56.5 million, with adjusted EBITDA up 3.9% year-over-year to R$152.0 million.
why: Irani is a notable packaging paper and sustainable packaging producer in Latin America, providing insight into regional industrial demand and input costs.

impacts.name: Irani
impacts.why: Higher quarterly profit and increased EBITDA reflect operational gains.
